term: primitive eternity calibration in a shared duration profile
definition: Analyst frame reusing canonical BoethianEternal, Interminable, TotaSimul, InPotency and PureAct. It supplies SAME beings/respects/life/time/state dictionaries, an admitted earlier-than relation and independent primitive Eternal. No order axiom or real-world adequacy is hidden in the frame. EndlessLife is nonempty life with no LifeBeginsOrEnds witness and permits succession; both calibrations and recognition are separate OPEN propositions. On an arbitrary admitted comparison relation the definitions express only those scoped witnesses; they do not independently ensure a complete continuum or atemporal life. Existing Boethian operational scope omits further perfecta/possessio connotations, unchanged. Motivating contrast is a life with endless succession versus a life with no succession; whether real subjects instantiate either remains OPEN.
note: Stipulated to connect an already checked operational result to the root primitive predicate without silently identifying definitions. A source attribution would require an explicit author-supported choice of calibration; attribution deferred. Actual applicability needs independent duration/life and recognition warrant.
